test_Siglip2Tokenizer_lowercasing: test Siglip2Tokenizer lowercasing behavior by tokenizing uppercase and lowercase text and comparing input_ids
test_Siglip2Tokenizer_batch: test Siglip2Tokenizer batch tokenization by passing a list of texts and verifying input_ids match
test_Siglip2Tokenizer_padding_truncation: test Siglip2Tokenizer padding and truncation by setting max_length and verifying all sequences match the length
test_Siglip2Tokenizer_save_load: test Siglip2Tokenizer save and load roundtrip by saving to a temp directory and reloading
test_Siglip2Tokenizer_from_pretrained: test Siglip2Tokenizer by loading from the HuggingFace hub using from_pretrained with a model id
